---
title: "How do I draw a reproducible random sample without replacement?"
---

## What the question asks

How do I draw a reproducible random sample without replacement?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Define the population IDs and required sample size.

2. Set a reproducible seed.

3. Call sample(population,size=n,replace=FALSE) and check duplicates.

## Runnable example

```{r}
population_ids <- 1:50
set.seed(12)
selected <- sample(population_ids,size=8,replace=FALSE)
print(selected)
stopifnot(length(selected)==8L,!anyDuplicated(selected))
```

## Interpret the result

The printed IDs form one eight-unit random sample from fifty possible IDs. A seed allows someone to reproduce the same demonstration.

## Check before using your own data

Set the seed when you need repeatability; check that the requested sample is no larger than the population.
